materialChanges: ResolvedRevision now carries repository identity (repo_id and repo_type) so a resolution object cannot silently act as a repository-independent commit authority.
Passing a ResolvedRevision to a different repository causes the requested revision to be resolved for that repository instead of reusing the old repository's commit oid.

hf-inference chat-completion eligibility no longer requires the conversational tag and can include text-generation or image-text-to-text pipeline-tagged models; SZL policy must remain stricter and independent.
Hub-host redirects used during file resolution are followed without forwarding Authorization off-Hub or following CDN redirects.

requirements: Preserve bucket-sync validation that rejects anchored/traversing remote keys escaping the selected destination.
Preserve safetensors detection that prevents an index-declared safetensors shard named .safetensors from falling through to pickle deserialization.

riskBoundaries.resolvedRevision: A receipt is authoritative only for the named repo_id, repo_type, requested revision, and resolved exact commit together.
riskBoundaries.inferenceEligibility: Upstream provider eligibility is availability metadata only and cannot add a model to an SZL serving allowlist or production route.
riskBoundaries.unsignedReleaseTag: The upstream annotated tag is observed but not cryptographically signature-verified; qualification binds the dereferenced exact release commit and records this limitation.
riskBoundaries.specializedPins: Do not blanket-upgrade workflows with older explicit Hub-client pins; each path requires compatibility evidence and ownership review.

estateAlignment.repairRule: Align only exact-source-sensitive/runtime paths proven compatible; preserve purpose-specific older pins until separately evaluated.

acceptance: Bind the Frontier record to release commit 48ef2781c2c4c2247431c97efcd5487e89d42732 and tag object 103720584dcc9865259dc5165f1a42e0bdea15d5.
Deterministically prove repository identity is part of any resolved-revision authority decision.
Reject or re-resolve any revision object presented for a repository other than the one it was resolved against.
Prove broadened upstream hf-inference eligibility cannot bypass the estate's own model allowlist, evaluation or production gates.
Retain v1.29 predecessor security behavior for bucket path traversal and safetensors/pickle separation.
Record exact installed client version and source evidence for runtime paths promoted to 1.30.0.
Keep production disposition HOLD until normal A11oy compatibility, source, runtime and rollback evidence passes.
